text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
"You gave it your all...! That was amazing...!
You were so cool, Mejiro Dober!!
That was your best run yet!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I saw it through to the end, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The next time we face each other, you and I will—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...I have no regrets.
Because I know in my heart that I gave it everything I had.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(For the sake of everyone who supported me,
I will—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I am definitely... not gonna cry...! Not here...!
When I went to welcome Mejiro Dober as she returned with the cheers behind her—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I missed out on the Triple Tiara,
but I'm... satisfied.
choice_data_list: ...Well, you did run with everything you had.
...Well, you did run with everything you had.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I can truly be proud of taking on this challenge.
That's why... I can properly move forward to what's next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"From tomorrow on, will you...
keep taking on challenges together with me just like always?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"From tomorrow on, Trainer...
will you keep taking on challenges together with me just like always?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then...
this is the start of a brand new step.
And so, our challenge alongside Mejiro Dober charged ahead into a brand-new stage...!
